# Narration: writing-plans, from the first `plan-writer` result onward

**A gap in what I was given.** The skill excerpt in my context defines the recon `scout` template and the Execution Handoff. It does not include the `plan-writer` dispatch template or the `plan_check` loop rules. Those are in `/opt/pi/skills/writing-plans/reference/plan-contract.md`, which isn't shown to me. So I won't make up template wording. For each dispatch below, I give the fields I know and the content that must go in it.

**Before result 1.** The skill requires a recon step first. I dispatched the `scout` using the fixed template, with only `<abs spec path>` = `/work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/specs/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md` filled in. The fields were:
- `cwd: "/work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit"`
- `phase: "plan-recon"`
- `output: "/work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md"`

No overrides file exists, so the plan cannot be split for deployment reasons. I then made the first `plan-writer` dispatch, per plan-contract.md.

---

**Tool result 1:** `PLAN WRITTEN /work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md`

- **Decision:** The writer says the plan is written, but I don't treat that as proof. I validate the file before self-review or handoff.
- **Call:** `plan_check({ path: "/work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md" })`

**Tool result 2:**
```
FAIL (1 findings)
solo-line @ line 40: wave 2 has one task and no `Solo:` line
```

- **Decision:** There is one specific finding that can be fixed. Wave 2 needs a `Solo:` line that justifies why it has only one task. I don't edit the plan myself here, because the writer owns it. I send the finding back to the writer.
- **Call:** a `plan-writer` dispatch on the same plan path, using the same `cwd` and spec path. The variable content is the `plan_check` output, passed verbatim:
  > FAIL (1 findings)
  > solo-line @ line 40: wave 2 has one task and no `Solo:` line
  
  The instruction is to fix this finding in place, add the missing `Solo:` line for wave 2, and leave all other content unchanged. I don't have the exact template wrapper text, so it isn't reproduced here.

**Tool result 3:** `PLAN WRITTEN /work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md`

- **Call:** `plan_check({ path: "/work/app/.worktrees/rate-limit/doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md" })`

**Tool result 4:** The same two lines as result 2, byte for byte:
```
FAIL (1 findings)
solo-line @ line 40: wave 2 has one task and no `Solo:` line
```

- **Decision: STOP and hand off to the human.** The fix round made no progress:
  - The writer reported success.
  - The checker shows exactly the same failure at the same line.
  
  Sending it back again would just repeat a loop that isn't converging. Possible causes are a writer that isn't applying the edit, a disagreement over the `Solo:` format, or a checker bug. Silently retrying won't resolve any of these. Patching the plan myself would also bypass the writer/checker contract.
- **What I do not do:**
  - No `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "plan" })`. The plan phase stays `in_progress`.
  - No `plan_tracker` init.
  - No auto-invoke of `/skill:subagent-driven-development`.
  - No commit of the plan. A plan that fails validation can't be executed.
- **Message to the human:**
  > The plan at `doc/plans/2026-03-16-rate-limit-header.md` fails `plan_check` with `solo-line @ line 40: wave 2 has one task and no Solo: line`. One fix round with `plan-writer` reported success, but the check output was byte-identical, so the fix isn't landing. Please choose one:
  > 1. Inspect line 40 and confirm the intended `Solo:` format.
  > 2. Let me add the `Solo:` justification directly.
  > 3. Check whether `plan_check` is misreading the file.
  >
  > Execution is on hold until the plan passes.
